arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A vector or a data frame.

origin.details: Labels and values are kept. On a data frame every column is updated.
origin.value: The same data with the format attributes removed.
origin.example:
x <- labelled(1:3, c(a = 1))
attr(x, "format.stata") <- "%9.0g"
z <- zap_formats(x)
cat(is.null(attr(z, "format.stata")), "\n")

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A vector or a data frame.

translation.details: Labels and values are kept. On a data frame every column is updated.
translation.value: The same data with the format attributes removed.
translation.example:
from haven import labelled, zap_formats
x = labelled([1, 2, 3], {"a": 1})
x.format_stata = "%9.0g"
print(zap_formats(x).format_stata)
